lines.scene: INT. BRIDGE OF KHAZAD-DÛM, MORIA - DAY
lines.dialogue: Fly, you fools!
Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day. At dawn ... look to the east. 202. THÉODEN Yes. Yes. The horn of Helm Hammerhand shall sound in the deep one last time!
Théoden king stands alone. ÉOMER Not alone. ÉOMER (CONT’D) Rohirrim! 204. THÉODEN Éomer. ÉOMER To the king! CUT TO:
Sauron’s wrath will be terrible, his retribution swift.
The battle for Helm’s Deep is over. The battle for Middle-earth is about to begin. All our hopes now lie with two little Hobbits...
